_comment: 'The next attack you BOOST this turn gets +4{p}' — WHICH attack was boosted cannot come from a turn marker, which records only that the player boosted at some point and would buff an attack that was never boosted. boost() now marks the card. 'This costs {r} less for each Hyper Driver you control' is a cost modifier and is declared as one so it affects play legality, not applied after the fact.
